question.problem:
For the matrix
$Y=[\begin{aligned}7 & -4 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 5 \\ 0 & -2 & 6\end{aligned}],$
find the minor ${M}_{13}$ of the entry ${y}_{13}.$

${M}_{13}=${{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
The minor of ${y}_{13}=2$ (first row, third column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $2$ are removed: 

$$
Y=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & ∗ \\ 0 & -2 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${y}_{13}=2$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{13} & =\text{det}[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot (-2)-3\cdot 0 \\  & =-2-0 \\  & =-2.\end{aligned}
$$
